worldcombat.skill.stormthrow.summary: Grab an adjacent foe and slam it into the ground for Fighting contact damage that always lands a critical hit, pinning it briefly (it cannot start new actions and moves slowly) and tearing up the ground where it lands. Pinning holds longer; the quick throw hits harder.
worldcombat.skill.stormthrow.use.0: Take out a single adjacent target
worldcombat.skill.stormthrow.use.1: Slam and briefly pin a charging threat
worldcombat.skill.stormthrow.use.2: Tear up the ground in a chokepoint
worldcombat.skill.stormthrow.description: The throw deals %1$s Fighting contact damage and always lands a critical hit; grab distance %2$s blocks.
The thrown foe is driven %2$s blocks down and cannot start new actions or move at full speed for %1$s.
The landing tears up about %1$s blocks of ground that linger %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.stormthrow.pin.on: Pinning throw: longer pin and a wider scar, at the cost of a little power and longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.stormthrow.pin.off: Quick throw: more power, a shorter pin, faster and cheaper.
worldcombat.skill.stormthrow.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.stormthrow.growth.0: From level %1$s the throw rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of crush.
worldcombat.skill.stormthrow.growth.1: From level %1$s the throw rises to %2$s power, %3$s of pin and %4$s blocks of scar.
On (pin): pin duration x1.4 and a wider scar, but power x0.9, +2 ticks wind-up and +8 ticks cooldown. Off (quick): power x1.12, a shorter pin, faster and cheaper.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in before throwing; it is a point-blank move.
On: targets attacking the companion or its owner rank higher, because pinning a charging foe pays best. Off: ordinary melee ordering.

world_combat.move.stormthrow.text.stagge: Slammed down · cannot act for %1$s s
